# Harrogate Cleaners

> Harrogate Cleaners is a dry cleaning, laundry and alterations shop at 34 Cold Bath Road, Harrogate, North Yorkshire HG2 0NA, England, established in 1986. Phone 01423 508568. Open Mon–Fri 9am–5:30pm, Sat 9am–5pm. Most items are ready in 2 days. A 24-hour express service is available for many items, depending on the garment and fabric.

## Services
- Dry cleaning: Suits, coats, dresses, knitwear, silk and delicates.
- Laundry & service wash: Bring a bag of everyday washing and we will wash, dry and fold it for you.
- Shirts: Shirts laundered and pressed, returned on a hanger or folded and boxed.
- Alterations & repairs: Hems taken up or let down, zips replaced, garments taken in or let out, and small repairs.
- Wedding & occasion wear: Wedding dresses pressed before the day, then cleaned and boxed afterwards so they keep.
- Duvets, curtains & bedding: Large items that will not fit, or should not go, in a home washing machine.
